body_en: Character shows in small choices: return a lost wallet, keep a promise, admit a mistake. Hard work beats empty talk. When you fail, own it and try a better way. Respect grows when you listen and keep secrets that are not yours to share. Doing the right thing is a skill you can practice every day.
body_zh: 品格显在小选择：归还钱包、守约、承认错误。实干胜过空谈。失败时认账，再换更好办法。倾听、不传不属于你的秘密，尊重才会长。做对的事是可以每天练习的技能。

exam_grounded.label: 做人与做事
